[Unit]

After=network.target

[Service]

WorkingDirectory=/var/www/celikpanel/subscriptions/2/sites/4/public_html
Environment=PORT=3001

Environment=PATH=/opt/celikpanel/runtimes/node/22.20.0/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin
